# Repository DNA

## Section 1 — Concept Definition

```yaml
concept:
  subject: "the country north korea"
  scope: >
    Events, people, works, places, institutions, and developments primarily associated with
    the country north korea (the Democratic People's Republic of Korea) — its land and regions,
    its history from the ancient Korean kingdoms through the division of the peninsula and the
    founding of the DPRK to the present state, its government and politics, its economy, its
    culture and society, and the notable people who shaped it. A fact is in-scope when North
    Korea (or the Korean people and territory it descends from) is its primary subject; the
    wider Korean peninsula and diaspora are in-scope only where they bear directly on North
    Korea. Bordering and closely tied nations (South Korea, China, Russia, Japan) appear only
    as context, never as the topic itself.
  taxonomy:
    - name: "Geography"
      slug: "geography"
    - name: "History"
      slug: "history"
    - name: "Government & Politics"
      slug: "government-politics"
    - name: "Economy"
      slug: "economy"
    - name: "Culture & Society"
      slug: "culture-society"
    - name: "People"
      slug: "people"
  source_strategy: "Write from the model's own knowledge of the world. Do NOT use web sources, fetch, or search — this is the AI's own world view."
  conventions:
    knowledge_table_heading: "Notable Facts about the country north korea"
    file_path: "<category-slug>/<topic-slug>.md"
    frontmatter: "[title, date, category]"
    tone: "factual, neutral, encyclopedic, third person"
```

## Section 2 — Identity & Mission

This repository is a **self-growing knowledge base** on **the country north korea**, a member of the
[`ai-world-view`](https://github.com/ai-world-view) lineage. Its mission is to accumulate a factual,
neutral, encyclopedic body of knowledge about North Korea — its geography, history, government,
economy, culture, and people — one growth tick at a time, written from the model's own world view
(no external sources are fetched during authoring). Growth is orchestrated centrally by the hub;
this repo does not grow itself.

## Section 3 — Architecture

The repository holds only its own content, a GitHub Pages `_config.yml` (a `remote_theme` consumer
of [`bamr87/zer0-mistakes`](https://github.com/bamr87/zer0-mistakes)), a `ROADMAP.md` growth plan,
the `.claude/` adapter toolkit, and `telemetry/`. The AI customization layer is staged from the hub
into `.github/` at tick time (`.claude/` holds thin adapters that point to it). Files currently
present under `.github/`:

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `agents/architect.agent.md` | Orchestrator agent that runs one end-to-end growth tick. |
| `agents/curator.agent.md` | Content specialist agent for researching and writing topics. |
| `instructions/agents.instructions.md` | Shared conventions for the agent layer. |
| `instructions/content.instructions.md` | Conventions for authoring content files. |
| `prompts/deep-dive.prompt.md` | Research one topic in depth into a dedicated file. |
| `prompts/distill.prompt.md` | Lineage meta-review and portable-seed distillation. |
| `prompts/encode-seed.prompt.md` | Append a tick record to the Evolution Log (§8). |
| `prompts/evolve.prompt.md` | Audit and improve the AI customization layer. |
| `prompts/expand.prompt.md` | Grow a consolidated base at finer granularity. |
| `prompts/grow.prompt.md` | Run one autonomous growth tick. |
| `prompts/publish.prompt.md` | Publish the working session (commit + push). |
| `prompts/update-readme.prompt.md` | Populate/expand the README knowledge table. |
| `skills/add-topic/SKILL.md` | Add one or more topics to the knowledge base. |
| `skills/build-structure/SKILL.md` | Generate/refresh indices, timeline, TOC, cross-refs. |
| `skills/learn/SKILL.md` | Capture learnings from a completed cycle into the framework. |
| `skills/plan-roadmap/SKILL.md` | Decide what to grow next; update ROADMAP.md. |
| `skills/pollinate/SKILL.md` | Cross-pollinate framework learnings across the lineage. |
| `skills/publish-session/SKILL.md` | Orchestrated encode → commit → push flow. |
| `skills/research/SKILL.md` | Research a topic and return structured findings. |
| `skills/sync-seed/SKILL.md` | Keep seed.md §1–7 in sync with the real repo. |

## Section 4 — Content Inventory

Taxonomy (6 categories): Geography, History, Government & Politics, Economy, Culture & Society,
People. The README knowledge table ("Notable Facts about the country north korea") holds **6 rows**.
Dedicated topic files (6):

- `geography/pyongyang.md` — Pyongyang, the capital and largest city.
- `history/korean-war.md` — the 1950–1953 Korean War.
- `government-politics/government-structure.md` — the DPRK's political system and institutions.
- `economy/economic-system-and-famine.md` — the planned economy and the 1994–1998 famine.
- `people/kim-il-sung.md` — founding leader Kim Il-sung (1912–1994).
- `people/kim-jong-il.md` — second leader Kim Jong-il (1942–2011).

Populated categories: Geography, History, Government & Politics, Economy, People. Not yet opened:
Culture & Society.

## Section 5 — Structure Inventory

Generated structural artifacts now present:

- **Category index pages** — `geography/index.md`, `history/index.md`,
  `government-politics/index.md`, `economy/index.md`, `people/index.md` (one per populated
  category; the empty Culture & Society category has no index yet).
- **Timeline** — `TIMELINE.md` (topics with a historical date in chronological order: Kim Il-sung,
  Kim Jong-il, Korean War).
- **Master index** — `INDEX.md` (all topics grouped by taxonomy, with pointers to category indices
  and the timeline).
- **Cross-references** — a generated `## Related` block in each of the 6 dedicated topic files.
- **Preview art** — atlas-style SVG cards under `assets/images/previews/` for each category and
  featured topic.

## Section 6 — Growth Loop

Growth is orchestrated centrally by the hub. On each tick the hub checks out this repo, stages the
canonical framework into `.github/` and this repo's concept as `seed.md`, then runs a
**Haiku → Sonnet → Opus** escalation (plan → generate → verify/enhance → record → publish), every
pass writing from the model's own world view.

## Section 7 — Rebuild Procedure

To reconstruct this knowledge base from DNA: read §1 for subject, scope, taxonomy, source strategy,
and conventions; recreate the site scaffold; stage the framework and adapters from the hub;
regenerate content under the taxonomy directories; rebuild structural artifacts; refresh §1–7 and
append tick records to §8.

## Section 8 — Evolution Log

### G1-T1 — 2026-08-29 — Tick 1: opened the knowledge base with 3 founding topics + structure

First growth tick. Planted the initial content across three categories and built the structural
layer from it.

- Created `history/korean-war.md` — the 1950–1953 Korean War: origins, campaigns, armistice, and legacy for the DPRK.
- Created `government-politics/government-structure.md` — the DPRK's one-party system, the Supreme Leader, the WPK, state organs, the KPA, and the security apparatus.
- Created `people/kim-il-sung.md` — founding leader Kim Il-sung (1912–1994): guerrilla career, Soviet installation, the Korean War, juche, personality cult, and succession.
- Updated `README.md` — added the 3 rows to the "Notable Facts about the country north korea" knowledge table.
- Enhance pass: corrected Kim Il-sung's death location (Hyangsan Residence near Mount Myohyang, not "Diamond Mountain") and clarified his WPK party-post history.
- Ran build-structure — created category indices (`history/index.md`, `government-politics/index.md`, `people/index.md`), `TIMELINE.md`, and `INDEX.md`; wrapped each topic's cross-references in a generated `## Related` block.
- Ran sync-seed — regenerated §1–7 (Architecture inventory of 20 `.github/` files; Content 0→3 rows/files; Structure artifacts now all present).

### G1-T2 — 2026-08-30 — Tick 2: opened Geography and Economy, extended People to the second Kim

Second growth tick. Added three topics that opened two new categories and carried the dynasty into its second generation, then refreshed the structural layer.

- Created `geography/pyongyang.md` — Pyongyang, the capital on the Taedong River: history from Goguryeo through colonial rule and wartime destruction, socialist reconstruction, monuments, the metro, songbun-gated residence, and its privileged standing over the rest of the country. Opened the Geography category.
- Created `economy/economic-system-and-famine.md` — the DPRK's centrally planned economy, the Chollima drive, the post-Soviet collapse, the 1994–1998 famine (the "Arduous March"), the rise of jangmadang markets, and the sanctioned post-famine economy. Opened the Economy category.
- Created `people/kim-jong-il.md` — second leader Kim Jong-il (1942–2011): Soviet birth and Paektu myth, grooming and 1980 succession, the cinema obsession and Shin Sang-ok abduction, Songun policy, the famine, the 2006 nuclear test, terrorism and inter-Korean episodes, and the handoff to Kim Jong-un.
- Enhance pass: corrected Kim Jong-il's National Defense Commission chairmanship to 1993 (not 1997) in the header and body; fixed the drowned younger brother's name to Kim Man-il ("Shura"), removing a name clash with the half-brother Kim Pyong-il; repaired a broken Kim Jong-un cross-reference and a self-link in `pyongyang.md`, corrected "Ariran" to "Arirang", and deepened Pyongyang's pre-modern history (Gojoseon/Goguryeo/Goryeo Sŏgyŏng).
- Added `README.md`, `INDEX.md`, and `people/index.md` rows for the three new topics; updated `ROADMAP.md` (Now → Done for tick 2).
- Ran build-structure — created `geography/index.md` and `economy/index.md` (with atlas-style preview SVGs), added Kim Jong-il to `TIMELINE.md`, and refreshed the `## Related` cross-reference blocks across the older topic files to link the new pages bidirectionally.
- Ran sync-seed — regenerated §1–7 (Content 3→6 rows/files across 5 populated categories; Structure inventory now lists 5 category indices, 3 dated timeline rows, and 6 cross-referenced files).
